title: "Sunita and Manhong bring home awards from IPSF 2026"
date: 2026-01-30
description: >
  Ph.D. student Sunita Shrestha won Best Oral Presentation in the SCAD
  category, and Manhong Wang received a Certificate of Excellence in
  Pathology plus a travel award at the International Poultry Scientific

categories: [Awards]
---

Two of our Ph.D. students were recognized at the 2026 International Poultry
Scientific Forum (IPSF) in Atlanta.

**Sunita Shrestha** won the **Best Oral Presentation Award** in the SCAD
category for her work on vaccine candidate identification against avian
pathogens using reverse vaccinology.

**Manhong Wang** received a **Certificate of Excellence in Pathology** and an
**IPSF Travel Award** for his culturomics research on the broiler cecal
microbiome.

Congratulations to both — this is what a strong year looks like.
